Read the pasture fields

Source: R/read.R
fpc_fields.Rd

Reads fields.parquet: one row per field with its geometry (EPSG:5070, CONUS Albers), tier, county, area, CDL pasture fraction per year, quality flags and soil, terrain and wetland attributes. See DATASHEET.md for every column.

Usage

fpc_fields(
  tier = NULL,
  county = NULL,
  fields = NULL,
  columns = NULL,
  geometry = TRUE,
  dir = NULL
)

Arguments

tier

Tiers to keep ("A", "B", "C"). NULL keeps all.

county

County names to keep, e.g. "Hardee" (case-insensitive, with or without "County"). NULL keeps all.

fields

Field identifiers to keep ("FPC000123"). NULL keeps all.

columns

Columns to read besides field_id, fid, tier and county. NULL reads all.

geometry

Return an sf object with the field polygons (TRUE) or a plain data frame.

dir

Data folder. Defaults to fpc_dir().

Value

An sf data frame (or a data frame), one row per field.

Details

Tiers: A, fields on parcels coded as grazing land; B, fields on other parcels that were mapped as pasture in nearly every year; C, open pasture from the official land-use maps that the Cropland Data Layer maps as woody or wetland. For a conservative set of grazing fields use tier A.

Examples

f <- fpc_fields(tier = "A", dir = fpc_example_dir())
f[, c("field_id", "tier", "county", "area_ha")]
#> Simple feature collection with 3 features and 4 fields
#> Geometry type: POLYGON
#> Dimension:     XY
#> Bounding box:  xmin: 1386915 ymin: 595965 xmax: 1391565 ymax: 605895
#> Projected CRS: NAD83 / Conus Albers
#>    field_id tier county area_ha                       geometry
#> 1 FPC060780    A Hardee   16.65 POLYGON ((1387455 605895, 1...
#> 2 FPC061123    A Hardee   10.53 POLYGON ((1391325 604905, 1...
#> 3 FPC062877    A Hardee  115.74 POLYGON ((1390095 597435, 1...
